message: No detected untrusted source handling: Remote calls (Google Elevation API, Mapbox API) are made with requests.get() without any checksum, signature verification, or integrity check on the returned data.
No detected label flipping detection: No label distribution comparison, expected-label validation, or noise-detection tool (e.g., Cleanlab) is present anywhere in the pipeline code.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The preprocessing validates station IDs and checks for NaN/shape/dtype in the feature array, but there is no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checking, or poisoning filter applied to the training dataset.

No detected model integrity verification: Models are loaded directly from the filesystem via lgb.Booster(model_file=arti_path) with no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision; only a count of artifacts is verified.

No detected label distribution validation: The training code (lgbm_regression_cv) performs k-fold cross-validation but contains no checks on label distribution, class balance, or anomalous sample detection before training.

No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no backdoor or trigger detection mechanism anywhere in the training loop or surrounding code; no activation analysis, neural cleanse, or gradient anomaly detection is present.

No detected differential privacy: The training uses standard LightGBM (lgb.train) with no differential privacy library (Opacus, TF Privacy, DP-SGD) or any noise-injection mechanism applied to the training process.

No detected adversarial robustness testing: There is no adversarial robustness testing (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, or similar) anywhere in the code; evaluation is limited to cross-validated MSE on clean data.

No detected metric tampering protection: The cross-validation in lgbm_regression_cv uses a single MSE metric with no held-out isolation, no signed/hashed evaluation data, and no multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation.

No detected output bounds checks: No checks are performed on the model's predicted trip time value (e.g., NaN guard, negative value check, or upper-bound sanity check) before it is returned to the caller or included in the response payload.
No detected prompt injection defenses: The model is a LightGBM gradient-boosted tree regressor, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable.
